# Tell users when an unsaved draft has expired

## What & Why
When the recovery window ends, the notice disappears but users who rely on announcements may not know that the draft is no longer recoverable. A clear, polite status message would make the expiry behavior understandable without requiring visual inspection.

## Done looks like
- Answer and opportunity expiry announce that the unsaved draft is no longer available
- The announcement does not claim a draft was saved
- Browser coverage verifies the expiry announcement for both draft types
